title: Para-Badminton Star Pramod Bhagat Named Flag Bearer for Asian Games
indian_angle: Para-badminton star Pramod Bhagat, a national hero, has been chosen to lead the Indian contingent as flag bearer at the upcoming Para Asian Games.
summary: India's Para Asian Games contingent received a warm send-off, where Union Minister Mandaviya unveiled their new jersey. A highlight was the announcement of para-badminton star Pramod Bhagat as the flag bearer for the Indian team.

title: Prakash Padukone Urges Greater Consistency from Indian Shuttlers
indian_angle: Indian badminton legend Prakash Padukone has voiced his expectations for improved consistency from the nation's shuttlers, offering valuable perspective on their performance.
summary: Indian badminton icon Prakash Padukone has called for greater consistency from the country's shuttlers, emphasizing the need for sustained high-level performance.

title: Sports Ministry to Review India's Asian Games Performance
indian_angle: The Sports Ministry will conduct a comprehensive review of India's performance at the 2026 Asian Games, a decision that impacts all Indian athletes, including badminton players.
summary: Following a perceived below-par showing at the 2026 Asian Games, the Indian Sports Ministry, led by Minister Mandaviya, is set to hold a detailed review meeting next week to assess the contingent's overall performance.

title: Tamil Nadu CM Launches 'Dream Olympics 2036' Scheme
indian_angle: Tamil Nadu's Chief Minister has announced an ambitious scheme to develop future Olympic champions, which promises significant infrastructure upgrades and support for athletes across all disciplines, including badminton.
summary: Tamil Nadu Chief Minister Vijay has unveiled the 'Dream Olympics 2036' scheme, an initiative aimed at producing champions in every sporting discipline by upgrading infrastructure, establishing new sports hostels, and providing modern facilities for athletes.

title: Pranavi Urs Recounts Historic Asian Games Golf Gold
indian_angle: Pranavi Urs made history as India's first-ever women's golf gold medallist at the Asian Games, a monumental achievement for the nation's sporting landscape.
summary: Pranavi Urs, India's first-ever women's golf gold medallist at the Asian Games, shares her journey and inspiration behind her historic win at Aichi-Nagoya, a victory that came down to the wire.
